name: Inspection Checklist
summary: A digital inspection app built for one-handed phone use in a workshop: pick a checklist (a 39-check vehicle inspection and a home or equipment inspection ship with it, both editable), then tap huge OK / Attention / Urgent buttons or swipe a check right for OK and left for attention, add a note and up to 3 photos per check, mark checks not applicable, 'Rest OK' a whole section, jump to the next unchecked item; a sticky progress bar with live traffic-light counts; customer signature; a polished printable and shareable report with the letterhead, a score, urgent and attention items first with photos, then OK checks by section; history with search and filters; a checklist editor; settings with storage meter and backup. Bold, fast, traffic-light colours that respect the style.
best_for: any trade that inspects and reports

sections.name: facts
sections.what: Hidden <template id="facts"> holding the business tokens (business, phone, email, address, year) that app.js reads for the header and the report letterhead
sections.edit: Leave the tokens in place; the owner can change these facts in the app's Settings

sections.name: view-list
sections.what: Home: date eyebrow, h1, sample-data note, a welcome card with 3 steps when empty, then 3 stats (in progress, done this month, urgent found), search, filter chips and the history grouped into In progress / Finished (rows built in app.js row())
sections.edit: Rewrite the h1, welcome heading, paragraph and steps in the owner's words; keep one h1 and the data-act / data-if attributes

sections.name: sheet-new
sections.what: The 'New inspection' sheet listing the checklists as big cards

sections.name: view-run
sections.what: Doing an inspection: sticky progress bar with OK / Attention / Urgent counts, a details card (customer with suggestions, phone, vehicle or item, mileage or reference, date, inspector, email), a swipe tip, the sections of checks, and a Finish card (overall notes, customer signature pad, finish button, delete); a side panel on computers and a Next unchecked / Report dock on phones
sections.edit: Labels and help text can be reworded; keep class names, ids and data-act attributes (app.js uses them). The labels Vehicle and Mileage come from the checklist

sections.name: row-section
sections.what: One section of checks: fold button with name and count, and a Rest OK button

sections.name: row-item
sections.what: One check: name (tap for note and photos), three big status buttons, and the note / photos / Not applicable panel
sections.edit: Button words can change (keep data-st values ok, attn, urgent)

sections.name: view-report
sections.what: The report page: header plus Send to customer, Print or PDF and Checklist buttons

sections.name: doc-report
sections.what: The printable customer report: letterhead from {{business}} {{address}} {{phone}} {{email}} (Settings can override), details, a score of urgent / attention / OK / not checked, urgent items then attention items with notes and photos, OK checks in columns by section, not checked and not applicable lists, notes, customer signature and inspector lines, footer
sections.edit: Rename the group headings to the owner's wording; keep data-t, data-if and data-slot attributes

sections.name: view-templates
sections.what: The checklists list with a New checklist button

sections.name: view-template
sections.what: Checklist editor that saves as you type: name, the two labels (what is inspected, reference), sections with drag handles, rename and delete, checks with drag, rename, delete (undo) and add, add section, duplicate, delete checklist

sections.name: view-settings
sections.what: Settings that save as you type: business details on reports, default inspector, report and note options, link to checklists, storage meter, backup (file or copied text, photos included), restore, sample data, help, erase

sections.name: sheets
sections.what: Body of the Send the report sheet (editable message, text, email, copy, print)

behaviors: starts empty with a welcome card; 'Try it with sample data' loads 2 clearly labelled sample inspections (one finished with a drawn 'Sample photo'), 'Clear sample data' removes only those

everything is saved on the phone and survives reloads: inspections and checklists in AK.store 'inspection-checklist', photos and signatures in a separate store 'inspection-photos' so taps stay fast; unused photos are cleaned up on the next start

each check: tap OK / Attention / Urgent (tap again to clear), or swipe right for OK and left for Needs attention on touch screens; Attention or Urgent opens the note box (setting); up to 3 photos per check, resized to 900 px; Not applicable; Rest OK per section with undo; Next unchecked scrolls to and highlights the next open check
sticky progress bar with live counts; finished sections without problems fold away; sections with problems stay open
customer signature pad; Finish warns about unchecked items, then shows the report
report groups by severity with photos, prints black on white with print-safe status colours, and is sent as a text message, email or copied text; Print or PDF includes the photos
checklists are copied into each inspection, so editing or deleting a checklist never changes past inspections
history with search (customer, phone, vehicle or item, reference, inspector) and filters (in progress, finished, with urgent); delete with confirm and undo
storage meter warns before the browser's roughly 5 MB fills up; backup includes photos
phone: bottom tabs, floating New inspection button, dock with Next unchecked and Report; computer: sidebar, side panel with progress ring
style_notes: Built on appkit, so it follows every style; tested at 390 and 1280 with workshop-industrial, clinical-clean, midnight-neon, soft-pastel, neo-brutalist and editorial-serif. Strongest with workshop-industrial, high-contrast-sport, clinical-clean and midnight-neon. Status colours are appkit's contrast-tuned --ak-ok / --ak-warn / --ak-bad (the 'more than one accent colour family' warning is expected); the style accent drives progress, main buttons and focus.
